newsitem.title: USA: Coin Bill Validator management buys shares.
newsitem.headline: Coin Bill Validator management buys shares.

text.p: Coin Bill Validator Inc said Tuesday that a group of company managers and employees had purchased a total of 75,000 shares of the company's stock from Joan Vogel, the widow of the company's founder and a member of the company's board of directors.
Coin Bill has 2.75 million shares outstanding.
The group purchasing the shares included Stephen Katz, chairman and chief executive officer,and others.
The 75,000 shares are restricted and must be held for a minimum of one year by the purchasers.
The agreement also says that Vogel will not sell any further shares of the company's common stock in the open market prior to January 31, 1998.
